message: Add an "∞" BPM option to the roll gap-threshold stepper that disables auto rolling annotation, and make it the default.

Make the vertical modal fill the bottom safe-area strip like the chart-options sheet: anchor its content with position:fixed bottom:0 (only a bottom-anchored fixed element paints into the home-indicator strip iOS keeps below the layout viewport) and keep the off-screen sheet visibility:hidden behind it.
Log vertical modal and bottom-sheet geometry to the Settings debug log to diagnose the on-device sheet-peek.
Block native touch-pan on the vertical modal so dragging it no longer rubber-bands the fixed layer (which briefly revealed the bottom sheet on iOS).
Fill the vertical modal's bottom safe-area band with scrollable content padding instead of a dead strip.
Add rolling manual annotation mode.
Support 2-2 rolling in auto annotation and hand inference.
Update version to 0.12.3.
Mock version.json in changelog panel visual test to keep its snapshot stable across version bumps.
Make auto zoom the default and drop the now-redundant auto-zoom setup from the README screenshot script.
Lock base page scroll when presenting modal.
Inset the vertical-layout bottom sheet by the left/right safe areas so its width stays out of them.
Hide the vertical-layout bottom sheet and floating actions while a modal page is presenting.
Clear all advanced search params on reset so stars range no longer persists in saved URL state.
Prevent OS mouse hovering popover for modal page title.
Rename "download .tja file" action to "export .tja file".
Remove file title from iOS image sharing so that destination apps perceive it better.
Add a web service for note gaps calculation.
Add a Python wrapper for the note gaps analysis.
Update version to 0.12.2.
Clean up artifacts after npm run release.
Avoid the transient expanded state when switching bottom sheet tabs while collapsed.
Dismiss the Wiki dropdown when the bottom sheet is dragged.
Stop the floating action pill overlapping the note stats panel in vertical layout.
Add a script to generate a composed screenshot with device bezels, and add the image to README.
Reduce `Any` usages in tests.
Attempt to fix a flaky test.
Allow customizing starting hand for annotations.
Update version to 0.12.1.
Hide the bottom sheet if there is no chart loaded.
Fix the issue where the wiki dropdown does not disappear when interacting with the bottom sheet.
Fix missing animation when exiting from full screen on some environments such as iOS.
A few optimizations on data source and chat option panel animation performance.
Update version to 0.12.0.
Avoid bottom sheet expansion if tab switch is triggered programmatically.
Move the exit full screen button to the bottom of the screen.
Auto-hide the floating chart action buttons (with fade) when they would extend outside the chart's visible region; show again when fully inside.
Add vertical layout test cases: mutually exclusive panel expansion logic and mobile-sized snapshot regressions.
Update floating buttons styling.
Moved full screen, image share and wiki buttons as floating buttons above bottom sheet in vertical layout. Added smooth position transition; disabled transition during drag.
Revamp the chart options layout in vertical mode as a bottom sheet. Make sure only one of data source and chart options panels can be expanded.
Update version to 0.11.7.
Update data.
Merge pull request #1 from OurTaiko/dev
Expand note gap calculation to support a few different modes when handling long notes.
Ignore 风船&连打
Update version to 0.11.6.
Replace the temporary local getEffectiveBpm solution with the new utility function from the renderer package. Also update usages of a renamed symbol.
Apply a quick fix to BPM calculation during note gap calculation.
Update TJARenderer submodule version.
Update README.md.
Update version to 0.11.5.
Hide the full screen chart graident overlay if no safe area in the top.
Disable PWA capability when app run in npm dev mode due to known issue.
Reintroduce renderer package as a git submodule.
Disable page zoom on mobile platforms.
Add missing data for a test case.
Refine the UI in advanced search. Allow selecting multiple difficulties and a range of stars.
Add a gradient overlay to the top safe area of the fullscreen chart.
Share note gap calculation logic between offline analysis and note stats panel. Fix the duration calculation with changing BPM in the note stats panel.
Update analyze-ese script to accept a unit parameter, supporting gaps output in ms.
Avoid the flash of modal pages when app opens.
Update package scripts to adapt to the separation of the renderer package. Move some tests out of this (app) repository.
Remove the renderer package for it to become a separate repository.
Make note hover and click handling API public, along with helper functions for annotations.
Move some chart annotation interaction logic from the app to the renderer package.

Include branch name in note location object. Update HitInfo to use note location. Remove some usages of optional branch name. For now, use normal branch name to express charts/sections with no branching.
Enable the hover style in the renderer package when only click handlers are configured.
Move hovered note style updates from the app to the renderer package.
Extend renderer internal API for hover/click event handler registration.
Minor refactoring in tja-chart to make calculateDirtyRowY a separate function.
Move image export implementation to the renderer. Eliminate usages of renderChart from the app.
Address some flaky tests.
Reduce browser environment dependency in layout.ts, add basic test cases.
Set up tests within the renderer package.
Add README to the TJA renderer package.
Define an internal/private version of ChartView API allowing easier migration of functionalities from the app package to the renderer package.
Rename renderer ViewOptions as RenderOptions to disambiguate from ChartViewOptions and the app ViewOptions.
Rename chart as chart view in public renderer API.
Remove the previously defined public API. Also make default chart options public.
Update the new public API. Migrate renderer example package to the new API.
Extend renderer public API and mark previous ones as deprecated.
Update version to 0.11.4.
Update TJA parser to calculate gaps that exceed 1 measure. Remove gap value when the previous note is not don/ka.
Add a script to apply analysis to all ESE charts that have a corresponding song mapping. Currently this contains only the note gaps.
Fix parameter propagation for prepare-data.
Update the data fetching script to use the taiko.wiki API instead of GitHub raw content address.
Update prepare-data script to invoke build-data in the end.
Update song_mapping.json.
Update prepare-data script to handle previously resolved ESE paths that no longer exist.
Update prepare-data script to replacet the deprecated version of TaikoRatingAnalyzer file with links to its CDN. Update parsing logic to adapt to the new format.
Update the importing process to allow storing unmatched entires.
Move the HTML importer function from settings-panel to a new file.
(Maybe failed) attempt to fix the gap between long note segments across bars.
Add debug logging for app startup performance.
Fix the issue where vertical inset is applied between the bars and the attribution text.
Add a script to package ESE data and upload to GitHub release, for potential offline support in the future.
Update version to 0.11.3.
Fix missing spacing between rendered chart header and the first bar.
Impove import process to skip the manual paste of HTML when importing to the web version of the app.
